{"consolidated_memory":"## Conflict loop issues in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (two separate occasions)

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-27]
- **Component**: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
- **Problem**: Conflict loop in sync engine
- **Trigger**: Issue appeared after client had already retried once
- **Signal**: Two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- **Root cause**: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix**: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR #2693** on branch **fix/conflict-loop-1**
- **Repro**: Edit the same note on two devices offline
- **Measured outcome**: Memory settled at 503 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB

### Occasion 2: [2026-05-23]
- **Component**: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
- **Problem**: Conflict loop in sync engine (same area of code as Occasion 1)
- **Trigger**: Issue appeared when two requests raced on the same key
- **Signal**: Two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- **Root cause**: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Fix**: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR #4626** on branch **fix/conflict-loop-2**
- **Repro**: Edit the same note on two devices offline
- **Measured outcome**: Backlog cleared 56 minutes after the deploy

Both occasions shared the same repro pattern but had distinct root causes requiring separate fixes."}
